group.name: Equivant
group.description: We are driven by a justice system that instills confidence through its processes and is accessible to all citizens. Like you, equivant aims to embrace community while advancing justice and deliver better outcomes to all who touch the justice system. We do this through our deep domain knowledge, modern technologies, and expert services that help promote public and individual safety by informing decisions at every step. As fellow stewards of justice, equivant is committed to your mission and we value your ideals. Our people operate with fairness and integrity, believing that there is no such thing as “good enough”.
